output.content: I checked the repository and the pipeline logs for the current forecasting cycle. The acceptance criteria for model validation are not stored in the configuration files. Instead, I observed the team manually copying threshold values from a shared document into the test scripts before every weekly retraining run. This manual step happens every Friday evening. I noted that the values change occasionally based on recent performance discussions, but there is no automated check that verifies these numbers against a central source. The process relies entirely on the person running the job to input the correct figures each time.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current manual workflow for updating validation thresholds and the absence of automated checks, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
